resource.title: International Patient Summary — OPCP Illness Pathway (PHC escalation → STRATEVAC)

type.text: Semi-serious illness onset at POI: cough, fever, chest pain on inspiration
R1 PHEC initial stabilization; MIST & MARCH; supplemental O2
R1 PHC: worsening dyspnea & fever; sepsis suspected; escalation triggered
Role 2: high-flow O2, IV antibiotics, imaging; transfer to R3
Role 3: ICU then ward; improvement but needs STRATEVAC
STRATEVAC to UK for continued care

resource.valueString: M: No trauma. Flu-like prodrome, pleuritic chest pain. I: Coarse crackles RLL, febrile. S: HR 104, RR 24, BP 120/78, Temp 38.3°C, SpO2 94% RA. T: O2 via nasal cannula; rapid CASEVAC.

component.valueString: tachypnea, bilateral air entry; crackles RLL

resource.valueString: M: Increasing work of breathing; persistent fever. I: Access x1, cap refill <2s; mild confusion intermittently. S: HR 112, RR 28, BP 116/74, Temp 39.1°C, SpO2 92% on O2. T: IV fluids 500 mL, antipyretic, broad-spectrum antibiotics ordered.

M: Worsening dyspnea; hypotension trend; suspected sepsis. I: New productive cough; purulent sputum. S: HR 122, RR 30, BP 102/64, Temp 39.6°C, SpO2 89% on O2. T: Sepsis bundle: cultures, IV fluids, broad-spectrum IV antibiotics, escalate to Role 2.

component.valueString: labored; crackles; low SpO2 on O2
